verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs explicitly claim identity-provider-based security for internal agents, apps, and deployments (vercel-docs-13) and Vercel Authentication/passwords/trusted IPs to gate preview and production URLs (vercel-docs-26), plus scope-limited access tokens (vercel-supp-scoped-tokens). However, evidence never names or details SSO/SAML/OIDC integration with third-party IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, etc.), no docs on SCIM provisioning, and community feedback notes enterprise-tier gating for 'basic security stuff' (vercel-comm-11), suggesting deeper IdP integration may be enterprise-only and not fully documented. Missing for 10: explicit IdP/SSO integration documentation (protocol, providers supported), SCIM/user-provisioning details, and independent confirmation of IdP-based agent/app security beyond marketing claims.
